200.title: Russia lacks forces for major NATO attack: Polish FM
200.summary: Russia does not currently have the forces to launch a major attack on NATO because its military remains tied up in Ukraine, Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski said in remarks reported Monday. Sikorski says Russian forces remain tied up in Ukraine Sikorski said Russia's military commitments in Ukraine limited its ability to carry out a large-scale attack against NATO.
200.body: Russia does not currently have the forces to launch a major attack on NATO because its military remains tied up in Ukraine, Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski said in remarks reported Monday. Speaking to Polish public broadcaster TVP Info, Sikorski said Moscow could instead attempt a smaller-scale provocation designed to create disagreement among NATO allies, including over whether the alliance's Article 5 mutual defense clause should apply. Sikorski says Russian forces remain tied up in Ukraine Sikorski said Russia's military commitments in Ukraine limited its ability to carry out a large-scale attack against NATO. "Russia doesn't have the forces for a major attack on NATO," he said.

200.body: President, defence minister thank Polish territorial troops for service Poland's President Karol Nawrocki and Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz expressed their gratitude to the Territorial Defence Forces (WOT) and praised their service on WOT Day on Sunday. 27.09.2026 17:57 update: 27.09.2026 17:58 Photo: PAP/Marcin Obara "You are always ready, always wherever Poland and the Polish people need you. 400.title: ERG and Glencore sign a PPA for the supply of over 800 GWh in Poland
400.summary: ERG, a leading independent renewable energy producer, has entered into a five-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Glencore Energy Europe B.V., one of the world’s largest global market commodities trader, for the sale of electricity generated by three of the group’s wind farms in Poland.
400.body: ERG, a leading independent renewable energy producer, has entered into a five-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Glencore Energy Europe B.V., one of the world’s largest global market commodities trader, for the sale of electricity generated by three of the group’s wind farms in Poland. The agreement, structured on a baseload profile and effective from 1 January 2027, covers the supply of 164 GWh of renewable electricity per year from the Radziejów, Slupia, and Szydlowo wind farms, representing approximately 70% of their expected output, for a total contracted volume of approximately 820 GWh over the five-year term. Paolo Merli, CEO of ERG, commented: “The PPA with Glencore, a leading player in the international energy markets, represents a further step in the implementation of our strategy to stabilise revenues through long-term contracts.
